name: What questions should I ask after receiving my roof inspection report?

mainEntity.name: What questions should I ask after receiving my roof inspection report?

acceptedAnswer.text: After receiving your roof inspection report, ask for clarification on any terms or identified issues you don't understand. Inquire about the urgency of recommended repairs, potential long-term implications of delaying fixes, and material options if a replacement is suggested. For Discounted Roofing Co. customers, discussing warranty options for new installations or significant repairs is also a valuable question to ensure long-term peace of mind.
acceptedAnswer.description: After receiving your report, ask for clarification on issues, urgency of repairs, potential long-term implications, material options, and warranty details.
